These figures indicate that the register nominally covers essentially the whole eligible electorate, although the EU EOM and other observers have flagged accuracy concerns, including the retention of deceased voters on the roll, meaning nominal coverage likely overstates the number of genuinely eligible active voters.

revised_comments: Lesotho does not maintain a cadastral register that is separate from its land register. The Land Administration Authority Act, 2010 established the Land Administration Authority (LAA) as a single body responsible for land registration, cadastre, mapping and surveying, unifying the previously distinct land registry, juridical cadastre and base-mapping functions into one authority. The LAA operates an Integrated Land Information System, built on the Landfolio platform with Esri ArcGIS providing survey and mapping tools, that combines cadastral and legal registry records within a single system rather than maintaining a standalone cadastral register.

Registration expanded significantly following the Millennium Challenge Corporation-funded systematic regularisation of some 55,000 urban parcels in Maseru between 2008 and 2013, with an estimated 2,200 additional parcels registered annually thereafter through sporadic registration.

revised_comments: Lesotho's business and tax registers are technically linked at the point of company incorporation. This linkage is confirmed for new company registrations; the extent of ongoing bidirectional data synchronisation beyond initial registration is not documented.
